turns.assistant_text:
Here are the 5 most recent tweets from Donald Trump:

1. **We’re going to bring this heroic young man, and his family, into the White House with, perhaps, the boy he saved, to give him a High Civilian Honor. Very brave, he deserves it! President DONALD J. TRUMP** - [View Tweet](https://x.com/realDonaldTrump/status/2082159711852298494)

2. **https://t.co/mxgaKQUZo1** - [View Tweet](https://x.com/realDonaldTrump/status/2073607119878623432)

3. **https://t.co/dVllGyDiPs** - [View Tweet](https://x.com/realDonaldTrump/status/2072681271566708832)

4. **RT @realDonaldTrump: POLL…** - [View Tweet](https://x.com/realDonaldTrump/status/2068431819603611979)

5. **POLL: ICE has been abused by the Fake News Media at levels never seen before. They are Great Patriots who work hard, and do a fantastic job in a very hostile environment. Much of this hostility is caused by the Dumocrats and the Fake News. The concept I have had for quite some time — A strong feeling that the name of these Patriots, “ICE,” should be changed to, “NICE,” in that it will totally discombobulate Crooked, Dishonest, and Unpatriotic Reporters and Journalists. For them to say, “We went to a NICE Facility today,” as opposed to “ICE” or, “NICE Agents have deported a Violent Drug Dealer,” they won’t be able to handle it, they will go totally crazy! All it means is adding an “N” (“National”) to “ICE (“Immigration and Customs Enforcement”) — A much more prestigious name. Everyone loves it, but I have been told by the legendary Tom Homan that the Agents do not love it as much as the other population. Who thinks that we should add an “N” to change the name of “ICE” to “NICE?” Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DJT** - [View Tweet](https://x.com/realDonaldTrump/status/2068370042018767262)
